title: Stable Diffusion Exposed: Gender Bias from Prompt to Image

bias_targets.methodology: Generating images from free-form triplet prompts (neutral, feminine, masculine) and measuring representational disparities using cosine similarity across the prompt, denoising, and image spaces. The paper also evaluates bias by using visual grounding models to extract generated objects and calculating co-occurrence bias scores to identify which objects are disproportionately associated with a specific gender.
